activity_summary: In the porch Master Thwaite turned the sand-glass twice, said he would be brief, and put Ash Wednesday three days off. You paid sixpence for firing and washing till Lady Day. Sir John Spencer sat three rows ahead and did not turn. Mistress Ansell showed the heel of the loaf, a penny and a finger short, and said she would not salt the house ahead of the church. Alse asked which hunger was hers. You left Gib on the Ovid, said you would be in close on nine, and went when the second glass was out.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Named Wednesday's salt, paid the sixpence, left Gib on the Ovid, and promised to be in close on nine.

entities.name: Master Josias Thwaite
entities.context: Turned the glass twice, said he would be brief, and kept Wednesday's reading for Wednesday.

entities.name: Mistress Dorcas Ansell
entities.context: Carried the heel of the loaf, took the sixpence, refused to salt the house early, and told the stair to expect him by nine.

entities.name: Alse Pinder
entities.context: Asked which hunger was hers, and whether to lay a trencher.

entities.name: Sir John Spencer
entities.context: Sat three rows ahead and did not speak.

facets.activity: Heard that Ash Wednesday was three days off

quotes.speaker: dorcas_ansell
quotes.text: The loaf this morning was a penny, and a finger short of the notch.

quotes.speaker: william_shakespeare
quotes.text: Close on nine. I have said it.
